name: user-login
description: Harden Target checkout sign-in detection, guest fallback, popup status, and Node tests
goals: Reliable sign-in/guest gate detection on Target checkout
Clear popup login status and toasts during sign-in
Node tests for sign-in helper logic without live Target.com
technicalNotes: Vanilla MV3 extension. Extract pure helpers to target-checkout-helper/core/signinStep.js for vm-based Node tests. Follow content.js patterns; never reload /checkout during sign-in.
_step_size: One logical change per commit. Quality over speed.

requirements.description: Extract sign-in step and guest-button helpers into core/signinStep.js with Node tests

patterns: IIFE content scripts import via script tags in manifest

acceptance: signinStep.js exports classifyPathAsSignin(path) returning true for /login and /signin paths
signinStep.js exports guestButtonNeedles array matching content.js guest copy
signinStep.js exports matchesGuestCheckoutText(text) true for 'continue as guest' case-insensitive
scripts/signin-step-test.mjs runs under node and exits 0
content.js uses shared helpers instead of duplicated inline logic

test.description: Create scripts/signin-step-test.mjs loading signinStep.js via vm and asserting path classification and guest text matching

implement.description: Create core/signinStep.js, register in manifest before content.js, refactor content.js to use it

refactor.description: Remove duplicated guest needle strings from content.js

requirements.description: Attempt guest checkout once when sign-in gate shows and auto sign-in is unavailable

patterns: One-shot flags per page load in content.js

acceptance: When step is signin and autoSignIn is false, tryGuestCheckoutOnce clicks first matching guest control
Guest attempt runs at most once per page load (guard flag)
When autoSignIn is true with credentials, guest path is skipped
Tests cover shouldAttemptGuest({ autoSignIn, hasCredentials, alreadyTried }) logic

test.description: Add shouldAttemptGuest and pickGuestButton tests to signin-step-test.mjs

implement.description: Add tryGuestCheckoutOnce in content.js sign-in branch using core helpers

refactor.description: Consolidate sign-in branch timing with existing checkout step watch

requirements.description: Improve popup login status labels and sign-in waiting toasts

patterns: setAcctItem for login dot in popup.js

acceptance: Popup login status shows 'Checking…' then resolved label within probe callback
content.js shows persistent toast on signin step when waiting for manual login
Auto sign-in toasts remain distinct for email, password, and submit phases

test.description: Add formatLoginStatusLabel helper test in signin-step-test.mjs or small popup helper test

implement.description: Update popup.js status strings and content.js toast messages per acceptance

refactor.description: Share status label strings between popup and tests

acceptance: node scripts/checkout-speed-test.mjs runs signin-step-test.mjs and fails if sign-in tests fail
autopilot.json tests feedback loop still passes after integration

test.description: Add failing integration hook in checkout-speed-test that expects signin-step-test to run

refactor.description: Print combined summary line for all Node extension tests
